data: USGS Landsat Collection 2 Level 2 Tier 1 only; public Planetary Computer STAC + point API
scaling: reflectance = DN × 0.0000275 − 0.2; algorithm input reflectance × 10000 rounded
qa: Tier 1 only. Exclude fill, saturation/terrain occlusion, cloud, dilated cloud, L8/9 cirrus, shadow, snow and reflectance outside [0,1]; retain clear/water and label separately
replay: Re-run on each valid-observation prefix after first 60 valid dates; no observations after as_of supplied
identification: Spectral changes only; inventory-guided sampling is not independent thaw-slump identification or validation
timeliness: Historical observation-time replay; actual catalog publication/processing latency unavailable, so not operational lead-time evidence
cross_sensor: TM/ETM+/OLI C2 common-band values; no additional cross-sensor harmonization, sensor transitions may produce apparent changes
